Hair PRP Treatment in Gurgaon — DenceSpot Clinic

Second page in the service-page set, built on the same system as the hair transplant page (Inter, #1a1147 / #10B981, 1280 container, 96px sections).

Three tweak chips above the artboard:
• Show working notes — the SEO spec block at the very bottom. Off = production page.
• Show stats — the 4.8 star line in the footer.
• Show session counts — the before/after metadata, keep off until the pairs are verified.

Placeholders to fill before this goes live:

• 10 image slots (hatched boxes) — each says what it needs.
• Per-session, course and maintenance prices in the cost section.
• Dr. Nyra's registration number and memberships.
• Metro / landmark / parking lines in "Getting here".
• Decide the canonical address: Sector 39 (used here, matches the Google listing) vs Chandwal Murdawan from the brief.
